sentences.japanese: 完璧であるには、欠点だけが欠けていた。
sentences.english: To be perfect she lacked just one defect.

sentences.japanese: 君は行動に慎重さを欠いていた。
sentences.english: You were careless in your action.

sentences.japanese: 空気と水は両方とも生命にとって欠くことができない。
sentences.english: Both air and water are indispensable for life.

sentences.japanese: 各色間の調和に欠けているのでこの絵は目立つ。
sentences.english: The lack of harmony between colors makes this painting stand out.

sentences.japanese: 我々は東部市場を開拓しようと言う気持ちが欠けている。
sentences.english: We lack an incentive for pursuing the eastern market.
